verdict.rationale: Jira ships first-party surfaces that let other tools and agents read and write the same work items: an official Atlassian MCP server, a versioned REST API with an OpenAPI spec, and Rovo AI that links assets and data from Confluence, Figma and third-party apps to the work. Jira issues can therefore act as a shared context carrier for handoffs. However, nothing documents an explicit tool-to-tool or agent-to-agent handoff that guarantees context is preserved. Missing for 10: documented agent-to-agent handoff workflow, explicit context/state preservation guarantees across tools, hands-on or independent corroboration of lossless handoff.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can hand off work between tools or agents without losing context or information

citations.quote: Rovo AI connects relevant assets and rich data from Confluence, Figma, and your 3rd party apps to your work.
Keep work up-to-date by tracking progress from your favorite tools like Slack, Figma and Gmail powered by an AI-assist
